title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
description: Example control (not official CIS text). Disabling direct root login over SSH reduces the impact of credential compromise and forces privileged access through an auditable sudo path.

evaluationDefinition.failureReason: PermitRootLogin is not explicitly set to "no" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.

remediationMetadata.summary: Set "PermitRootLogin no" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd.

title: Ensure SSH protocol version is not set to an insecure value
description: Example control (not official CIS text). Modern sshd defaults to protocol 2; explicit protocol 1 configuration should not be present.

remediationMetadata.summary: Remove any "Protocol 1" directive so sshd uses the SSH-2 default.
